name: Baidu Qianfan
description: Baidu's ERNIE platform with a small new-account trial.
overview: Qianfan serves Baidu's ERNIE family and open models through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. New accounts get CNY 20 of trial quota; terms limit user-data use to service delivery but permit compliance review and publish no plan-wide no-training commitment.
notes: Chinese real-name verification is required to claim the trial.
